assets.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Elegant flat geometric illustration with a little dimensional depth and spacious clean background, crisp typography, excellent readability at README width. Exact prominent text: "Retina". Small secondary exact text: "Visual validation for web and mobile". Use a restrained dark ink and warm white scheme with a single bright blue signal accent. Show deliberate alignment guides and two small highlighted regions, not a busy dashboard. No fabricated charts, test results, badges, screenshots, green success metrics, human eyes, photoreal eyes, code blocks, watermarks, or extra text. Keep important content comfortably within frame. High quality brand concept artwork, not a screenshot of existing software.

A beautifully balanced geometric optical aperture or concentric focus mark, with one precise offset segment suggesting detection of a visual difference. Clean minimal bold silhouette readable at 32px, crisp almost vector-like raster finish, dark ink on warm white background with a single small bright blue accent. Centered, generous whitespace, flat design, no gradients, no mockup, no human eye, no letters, no text, no watermark. A coherent, original professional software project identity.
